next.chatgpt.card.foot: Your own ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan, for a plain chat without an agent. The sign-in is personal: don't share it with other people. Its usage counts toward your ChatGPT limits — see them in ChatGPT's settings.
next.chatgpt.emptyNote: A plain chat on your ChatGPT plan: no agent, no files of this machine.
next.chatgpt.err.accountMismatch: This is a different ChatGPT account. Sign in with the one you chose.
next.chatgpt.err.badCallback: That's not the address of the sign-in's end. Copy the whole address from the browser bar.
next.chatgpt.err.busy: An answer is still coming. Wait or stop it.
next.chatgpt.err.denied: The sign-in was cancelled in ChatGPT.
next.chatgpt.err.incomplete: The answer stopped before the end. Try again.
next.chatgpt.err.network: ChatGPT didn't answer. Check the connection and try again.
next.chatgpt.err.noPlan: ChatGPT didn't allow using your plan here. Sign in again and allow it.
next.chatgpt.err.notEligible: This ChatGPT plan can't be used in other apps.
next.chatgpt.err.signedOut: The ChatGPT sign-in expired. Sign in again in Settings.
next.chatgpt.err.state: This sign-in is out of date. Start it again.
next.chatgpt.err.tooMany: Too many chats. Delete the old ones.
next.chatgpt.err.unavailable: ChatGPT is unavailable right now. Try later.
next.chatgpt.err.usageLimit: The limit of your ChatGPT plan is used up.
next.chatgpt.file.size: The file is larger than 20 MB
next.chatgpt.file.type: Pictures, PDF and text files only
